item.title: And after everything, I just couldn't stand looking at the things we once called "ours".
item.description: And after everything, I just couldn't stand looking at the things we once called "ours". It wasn't event about revenge (none of it ever has been), it was about energy. Some things were just objects but others were soaked in memories I didn't want to carry into my new chapter. So I sold/gave away/donated it all. Every last bit. The dishes, the sofa, bed, towels... gone. I wanted to build something completely new, something that felt like me again or the new version of me. #SingleMumLife #lifeafterdivorce #newbeginnings #singlemum #coparenting
